change: In the frozen V3 M3 route price, the KV-session term of a visited GPU uses the decode service of all resident layers of that GPU instead of only the layer slice the request runs there. Canonical (full-segment) paths are priced exactly as in frozen V3.
selection_on_formal_seeds: none; the rule was fixed before the development window and is not tuned

development.use: runner check and mechanism description only; not part of the decision

controls.v3: released benchmarks/runs/{single,multi}/seed*/rcaps_v3.json; rerun here for parity and hop records

rules.R1_no_harm: On both topologies the mean throughput change vs frozen V3 is >= -0.5% and the mean P95 TPOT change is <= 0.
rules.R2_single_gap: On C1_single the mean P95 TPOT gap between frozen V3 and canonical routes shrinks by >= 50%, and P95 TPOT falls on all three seeds.
rules.R3_multi_retained: On C1_multi the mean P95 TTFT rises by at most 2% vs frozen V3, and the candidate keeps lower mean P95 TTFT and P95 TPOT than canonical routes.

decision.adopt_if: R1 and R2 and R3; otherwise report as a negative result
decision.failures: Any failed window is kept as .failure.json and counts as not passing; it is not rerun to fill the table.
